Overview

Takamatsu is a city in Kagawa with a population of 420,000. The gateway to Shikoku, famous for the stunning Ritsurin Garden, Sanuki udon noodles, and the Seto Inland Sea. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
